quienesSomos.photoAlt: Jackson Bohorquez, CEO of Cyrrus Consulting Services
quienesSomos.bio: Jackson Bohorquez founded Cyrrus Consulting Services to close the gap he sees causing most organizations to fail: not a lack of strategy or technology, but the fact that no one connects the decision to the execution. That's where the CIRA method was born — Construct, Identify, Realize, Adopt — the framework that now guides Cyrrus's digital transformation projects in more than 17 countries.
quienesSomos.quote: "Organizations don't fail for lack of strategy or technology. They fail when no one connects the decision to the execution. CIRA exists to close exactly that gap."
